notes.note: Reviewed the retained sync qualification delta. The service now captures the actual adapter and native Session binding before its runtime preflight, and refuses if either changes across that wait. Only Claude currently supplies the qualifier. This capability is still private, and the normal dispatch, portability, approval, and request inspection routes retain their existing owners. The synthetic request inspection captures remain evidence for that original scenario.
